errors.text: It identifies free surfaces as the nucleation sites, whereas the target bulk periodic model attributes nucleation to vacancy clusters or locally disordered atoms.
It predicts maximum yield strength along <110>, while the target result places the maximum along <-111>.
It conflates quaternary FeNiCrMn with the quinary CoCrFeMnNi alloy and alternates between bulk and nanowire geometries.

The cited evidence concerns CoNiCrFeMn nanowires with free-surface-mediated twinning and phase transformation, making it inapplicable to the periodic bulk FeNiCrMn system and partly contradictory to the target observations.
